games.name: Aeronautica
games.desc:
Train, Buy, Fly - Aeronautica is an open-world flight simulator with economy elements where the goal is entirely up to you. Earn money by completing unique jobs or flights between distant islands and continents. You can even create an airline for you and your friends to join! 

Train and earn licenses to unlock exciting new vehicles. Customize and maintain your vehicles as you work your way up from the smallest ultralights to the world’s largest airliners like the Airbus A380 Superjumbo. 

In Aeronautica you can explore:

> ✈️ 800+ unique vehicles in 10 different classes to unlock. Ranging from airliners to ultralights, and fighter jets to boats 
> 🛫 210+ airports and heliports, ranging from dirt runways to large international airports 
> 💸 Custom player-run airlines for you and your friends 
> 📈 Fluctuating player-driven markets where you can sell your acquired aircraft and parts 
> 🎨 Customizable liveries and vehicles
> ⛈️ Dynamic weather

games.name: Indo Voice
games.desc:
Welcome to Indo Voice!

Enter a colorful social world where your voice is the center of attention! Indo Voice is our 4th creation, continuing a long tradition of delivering the best social experience. As the pioneer of hangout games in Indonesia since 2014, we have dedicated more than a decade to perfecting the art of play and socialization.

💖 Features & Activities:
- Connect - Meet and chat with friends from all over Indonesia! 🇮🇩
- Voice Chat - Real-time chat for a more realistic experience! 🗣️
- Appreciate - Give & Receive Hearts to share a positive aura!
- Express - Share stories, jokes, or sing your favorite song! 🎶
- Fish & Play - Be on the edge while fishing or playing mini-games! 🎣🎮
- Customize - Look different with exclusive Aura, Trail, Pet, and Tools! ✨
- Vibe - Show off your style with a variety of dance emotes and movements! 🕺

games.name: Princess Tycoon
games.desc:
Welcome to Princess Tycoon 😄, choose your favorite princess 👸 and build 🧱 your tycoon! 

You purchase droppers 🏗️ that generate cash 💸, when you have enough cash you will be able to unlock different weapons ⚔️ of your chosen princess and unlock the princess outfit 👗.

The objective of the game is to unlock all weapons 🗡️ of the chosen princess and the princess outfit inside your tycoon 👑! Fight others to defend your tycoon and become the most powerful princess ✨ in the game! Make sure to invite or make friends 👥 along the way that can help you build your tycoon and fight others 👊!

Join The Tycoon Squad ✌️ for 2,500 starting cash 💰:
https://www.roblox.com/groups/group.aspx?gid=4965451
In the group, you can also find our other tycoon games 🎮, and you can chat with the community 👪. Make sure to post about your game/update ideas 🤔 on our group wall!

Make sure to favorite ⭐ and thumbs up 👍 the game to show your support!
